cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

mechanism: A handles a spill by creating permit authority, then adds oversight to the newly created authority when its reliability is questioned.
confusable: D188 celebrates existing safeguards; D192 actively adds a rule or oversight layer to each problem.
comparison: A serving accident and supervisor certification differ from organizing a family photograph.
seedUse: Keep the spill/supervisor worry but replace unexplained appeals with oversight that actually addresses it.
